title: Inflation termination for classical pair-source networks
abstract: For finite binary pair-source networks without isolated vertices, classifies when the inflation hierarchy characterizes compatibility with finite latent alphabets: precisely forests of double stars, where order two suffices. Also proves triangle nontermination for arbitrary measurable latent probability spaces, quantitative obstructions, finite and measurable Finner inequalities, and graph witnesses.

informal.TriangleInflation.Graph.classification_N: For finite binary pair-source graphs without isolated vertices, some finite order of the Navascués–Wolfe hierarchy characterizes compatibility with finite latent alphabets exactly for double-star forests; order two suffices there.
informal.TriangleInflation.no_finite_characterizi: At every positive inflation order, a triangle law passes both the AI and NW tests but has no compatible model over any measurable latent probability spaces.
